ios.desc:
Rotator turns everything you juggle into lists that run themselves — chore rotations, meal plans, shared shopping lists, family pin boards. Stop deciding, start rotating.

WHY A ROTATION LIST?

A list remembers. A rotation list decides. Whose turn is it to pick the movie? What's for dinner Thursday? Which workout is next? Rotator advances automatically on your schedule — daily, weekly, monthly, or whenever you tap — so the next thing is always waiting for you.

NEW: PIN BOARDS

Turn any list into a shared cork board. Photos become polaroids, notes become handwritten stickies, dates become countdowns, recordings become voice memo pins. Drag anything anywhere — your arrangement syncs to every device and every person you share with. Choose Cork, Blackboard, Whiteboard, or Linen. Put the important thing in the middle and the fun thing in the corner, and next Tuesday it's still right there.

SIX KINDS OF LISTS

- Rotation Lists: cycle in order, randomly, or weighted toward favorites
- Checklists: simple checkmarks, to-dos, or three-state progress tracking
- Shopping Lists: quantities, price estimates, budgets, grouped by store
- Tier Lists: drag items into S+ through F ranks
- Top 10 Lists: ranked lists your group can vote on
- Pin Boards: free-form boards for the stuff that matters

BUILT FOR FAMILIES, COUPLES, AND ROOMMATES

Share any list and collaborate in real time. Assign chores, vote on movie night, chat inside the list, and watch updates land on everyone's devices instantly. Turn-taking without the arguments.

CREATE LISTS IN SECONDS

Speak it: describe a list out loud and AI builds it — items, schedule, colors, even a board layout. Scan it: point your camera at a paper list or whiteboard and OCR turns it into a list. Share it: send text, links, or PDFs from any app straight into Rotator. Or browse community templates in Discover and start with one tap.

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE

Interactive home screen widgets let you check off items and rotate without opening the app. Pin board widgets put your board on your home screen. Quick Add lives in Control Center and on your lock screen. There's a native Apple Watch app for your wrist, and iCloud keeps every device in sync — no accounts, no sign-ups, your data stays in your iCloud.

SMART SCHEDULING

Automatic rotation on any cadence with reminders before it's your turn. See everything coming in list, calendar, or hour-by-hour timeline views.

PEOPLE USE ROTATOR FOR

Chore charts and allowance turns. Dinner rotation
